title: MI60033: Advanced Subsurface Metal Mining
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Techno-economic analysis on choice of stoping methods, high productivity
methods: blasthole stoping, vertical retreat method of mining, block caving,
raise stoping, underground bench blasting, step mining methods, special
underground excavations: ore transfer raises, ramp, decline, stope design and
production planning, methods of pillar extraction, hot muck mining, solution
mining: in situ leaching, underground retorting, under-sea mining, introduction
to novel mining methods, Application of nuclear blasting in underground mining.
